The '''head''' of [[House Barnaba]], one of the [[Tapani Noble Houses]], [[Death/Legends|died]] without an heir during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], causing the family to splinter in separate bids for leadership.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Disputed Succession}}</ref>
